scope: Model/editor quality-v2 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0110; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Quality-v2 remediation rechecked learner-facing English, removed known weak/teacher-directive patterns where present, and kept the bounded target pragmatically licensed by its prompt.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently renders bad as «بد/نامناسب».

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Placeholder/generic distractors were removed where present; choices use contrastive alternatives with distinct teaching feedback.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: The scene and adjacent turns were checked again so character prompts function as dialogue rather than teacher commands.

difficultyFit.evidence: Both learner responses use familiar be patterns and one new adjective.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner turn transfers bad from coffee to tea.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, scenario, dialogue and assessment all target the same quality sense.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; boredom, perceived difficulty and retention remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or learner test has been performed.
